name: Forsaken
overview: The theme of being forsaken is poignantly captured in Jesus’ cry on the cross, expressing the depth of His suffering and separation from the Father. Scripture contrasts this ultimate moment of forsakenness with the call to choose life, highlighting the blessing of obedience and the curse of turning away, as seen in Deuteronomy's presentation of choices. Psalm 37 encourages believers to depart from evil and do good, promising a lasting dwelling, which underscores God's faithfulness even when we face trials or feelings of abandonment.
